title: Musk v. Altman: internal 2017 emails show Musk sought majority voting control over OpenAI co-founders, withheld promised funding, and tried to poach researchers (Wired)
summary: Wired: Musk v. Altman: internal 2017 emails show Musk sought majority voting control over OpenAI co-founders, withheld promised funding, and tried to poach researchers — Tensions flared on the third day of trial in Musk v. Altman as OpenAI's lawyers cross-examined Musk.
